I want you to assist me to claim this money as I cannot claim it directly because I am still a Civil servant in active service, and the code of conduct bureau forbids me to acquire such huge amount of money. Kindly respond to my proposal through this my private email on the receipt of your mail indicating interest. I want to assure you that this is 100% risk-free. I will give you more details concerning this as soon as I received your swift response which must include your full names, address, occupation, age phone and fax number. Expecting your response. Yours sincerely, Mr Mark Hernandez.
